purpose: byte-exact Web/Android/iOS Rust bridge replay on real mirror-gym pose observations plus research-only geometry bar-axis observations

source.scene: front barbell bench press with wall mirror and gym bystanders

observation.detector: YOLOX-nano HumanArt boxes retained from raw sidecar
observation.pose: RTMPose-m Halpe-26 rerun independently on every candidate box
observation.candidateIdPolicy: frame IoU >= 0.2; identical to Web/Android/iOS adapters
observation.missingPointPolicy: no synthesis, no candidate mixing, raw finite RTMPose points only
